QuestInfo.name: What's in a Phantom?
QuestInfo.1: The final journals from your former master, Raven, should still be at the secret vault in #b#m240000000##k.
QuestInfo.2: You arrived at the vault in #m240000000#. If you remember correctly, a powerful #o9001047# guards this one because of all the valuables. It might be difficult to make it inside.
QuestInfo.0: You reached level 100. It's time to show the world why Phantom was known as the greatest thief of all time.

no.0: I bet nobody expected me to make it this far. I'm pretty great.

0.0: Level 100, the big time! Time to get my 4th Job Advancement done and become the master everybody knows I am. Pickpockets in the street are going to be chanting my name!
0.1: No time like the present. Just a quick jet over to #b#m240000000##k to the vault behind #b#m240010101##k, and I should be able to get that old journal back.\r\n#b#e<You will be moved to #m240000000# #m240010102# if you accept.>#n#k

1.0: The vault at #m240000000#... that's where I kept all my favorite things. A robber wouldn't even know what to do with most of those old keepsakes. Why, oh why, did I decide to leave that #o9001047# to guard the place?
